column1: # Persona 5 Royal 1.0.2, SDK 13.3.2. Atlus GFD / Needle, NVN, CRI middleware.
# Mac bring-up and validation: README.md beside this profile.
# Without it a frame stood in the display link's queue for a whole session on an iPhone 18 Pro Max (the 0.5 build, 60 fps, edge smoothing): game enqueue to display 46.9-48.4 ms.
# 60 ticks in a row with two or more frames waiting drop one (DM_PRESENT_TRIM, which env.txt can set, 0 for off): 32.4-32.8 ms, 1 trim in 2 minutes of play, frame interval p99
# 16.8-17.0 ms (16.9-18.0 without), no underruns. Checked only on iOS; the Mac uses it untested
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon

# the NVN depth mode the game sets (nvnDeviceSetDepthMode near = 0; the iPhone 18 log: "the game's depth mode is not the one built for"): the pipeline archive made offline holds the main0_z vertex entries (dm/gfx/tools/pso_offline.py)
# The rewritten modules require 76 MB, more than the default 64 MB deducted from the pool.
# The game asks for present interval 2 (30 fps) and steps its logic by its own clock: the community 60 fps patch for 1.0.2 (StevensND) only turns that 2 into 1, in the sdk's
# NVN (sdk+0x486ca0, mov w8, #1), which the host replaces, so the patch has no effect here. present_interval display does the same at the host: 60 fps on an iPhone 18 Pro Max
# at normal speed (2026-11-05). The launcher offers it as Frame rate 30 / 60 (README.md)
